verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can draft and refine documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and PDFs, take requests for specific changes, and let you download the completed file. Iterative editing is supported through annotations that target a specific part of a preview, such as marking a chart on a slide to fix its label. Deck creation from notes and template-fitting output are also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of file creation, iterative editing and export quality.
